Topics · The prophets

If all prophets said the same, what do I do?

Four things, all in the Quran: no distinction among prophets, a fair common word, good work, and full freedom.

Part 1 of 4

﴿قُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, [O believers], "We have believed in Allāh and what has been revealed to us and what has been revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants [al-Asbāṭ][48] and what was given to Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

Translator's notes

[48] The twelve tribes of Israel descended from Jacob.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:136

Translation

They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in Yahweh your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”

Original · Hebrew

2 Chronicles · 20:20

World English Bible

In a large, scattered family, a grandson comes to an old gathering carrying pictures of all the forebears. I am not here to take anyone's picture down, he says. I came to hang them all. Some hesitate. Some come forward. For the first time in years the wall is whole.

A question for you

Which of these names is closest to you?

If you sayMoses.
ThenThen you are at home here. His first sentence on the one God stands in all of this.
If you sayJesus.
ThenThen he is honoured here, by name, in that same sentence.
If you sayAbraham.
ThenThen you stand at the root where all of them meet.
If you sayMuhammad.
ThenThen the verse tells you that loving him includes all who came before him.

Part 2 of 4

﴿قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allāh and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allāh."[128] But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."

Translator's notes

[128] By obeying another in disobedience to Allāh.

Quran · Aal Imran 3:64

Translation

For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

Original · Hebrew

כִּֽי־אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ אֶל־עַמִּ֖ים שָׂפָ֣ה בְרוּרָ֑ה לִקְרֹ֤א כֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְעָבְד֖וֹ שְׁכֶ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃

Zephaniah · 3:9

World English Bible

Two villages with an old quarrel meet at the only well. The eldest says: leave aside what divided us. Can we agree that the water is God's, and that none of us is master of the other? Everyone falls quiet. The first bucket goes down.

A question for you

Where is this word hardest for you to keep?

If you sayIn what people think of me.
ThenAn old test. Those who say they have no lord but God are freed from much of that.
If you sayIn money and worry over my living.
ThenThen the word begins in your daily life, and not in books.
If you sayIn those I revere.
ThenAn honest answer. The verse says this to everyone, every community included.

﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

Quran · Al-Kahf 18:110

Translation

When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him. But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

Acts · 10:25-26

World English Bible

A girl asks her grandfather: where do I begin? He opens the door and points to an old neighbour carrying her water alone. He says nothing more. The girl carries the water, and nobody sees. On her way back she knows that she has begun.

A question for you

What small good work could you begin with today?

﴿لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become distinct from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in ṭāghūt[104] and believes in Allāh has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

Translator's notes

[104] False objects of worship, such as idols, heavenly bodies, spirits, human beings, etc.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:256

Translation

But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

χωρὶς δὲ τῆς σῆς γνώμης οὐδὲν ἠθέλησα ποιῆσαι, ἵνα μὴ ὡς κατὰ ἀνάγκην τὸ ἀγαθόν σου ᾖ ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἑκούσιον·

Philemon · 1:14

World English Bible

A guide brings a traveller to a fork in the road, shows him every landmark, and sits down. He does not push him or take his hand. The way is clear, he says, and the step is yours. The traveller sits looking for a long time. He has never felt so free.

A question for you

Where would you like to go from here?

If you sayWhat is the straight path?
ThenThat has its own Step, open to you.
If you sayI think I believe.
ThenThat has its own Step too, with no hurry.
If you sayI want to keep weighing.
ThenA good place to be. All the strands are gathered in one Step.

The same in the other books
